item.title: The Gap Between Solar Install and STC Payment: How Lodgement Timing Hurts Your Cashflow
item.description:
The job is done. The panels are on the roof, the customer is happy, the crew has moved to the next site. And your money is still sitting on someone else’s desk.

This is the part of the solar business nobody puts in the brochure. You have paid for the panels, paid the crew, covered the fuel and the cranage, and the Small-scale Technology Certificates (STCs) that make the numbers work have not turned into cash yet. For a one-job-a-week operation that is an annoyance. For a business turning over 20, 30 or 50 jobs a month, it is a structural cashflow problem that quietly decides whether you can make payroll without dipping into an overdraft.
